scientific_integrity: The relative-chain proof explicitly handles integral lattice saturation and signs. Literature comparisons distinguish sink from ordinary collision-free configurations; no claim is made about independent validation or exhaustive bibliographic coverage.
scientific_limitations: Exactly two labeled particles; all original vertices are sinks; all-size integral homology but only rational representation decompositions for side-preserving vertex permutations and particle swap. The extra side interchange at equal part sizes, arbitrary sink subsets, cup products, and higher particle counts are not determined. A finite checker supports but cannot prove unbounded statements.
title: Integral homology and particle-swap modules of two-point sink configurations on complete bipartite graphs
